messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deployment failed for release user-service chart=redwood/user-service v=3.2.1 namespace=canary. Health-check: webhook reject (values schema mismatch). Logs: https://ci.redwood/s/infra/logs/1790002431 :warning:

alex: Seen this. Canary pods never become ready, status 422 from admission webhook. Any recent values changes? :eyes:

maya: I pushed a values tweak earlier for session affinity defaults. Could that be it? I edited values.canary.sessionAffinity in our repo.

jon: Checking helm diff from CI: `helm diff upgrade --allow-unreleased user-service ./charts/user-service --values values/canary.yaml` shows added field `sessionAffinity: "ClientIP"` under service. Chart expects `serviceSessionAffinity` (renamed in chart 3.2.1). So schema changed in chart, values incompatible.

sophia: That explains it. Chart 3.2.1 changed the key mapping (breaking). CI unit tests didn't catch because they use stable values set.

leah: Two choices: (A) rollback canary to chart v3.2.0 (pin) while we patch values and cut 3.2.2, or (B) hotfix values in repo and force-canary with `--force` (risky). Thoughts? We also need to note change window for user-facing deploys today at 16:00 PT.

alex: Prefer rollback to v3.2.0 for canary only. Minimize blast radius. Patch chart upstream then cut 3.2.2. We should also update release notes to mention the key rename.

deploy-bot: Proposed action: revert canary chart to 3.2.0 for canary deployment, keep main stable unchanged. Post-rollout sanity checks will run. Approve with `:thumbsup:` to proceed.

maya: +1. I'll open a quick PR that pins the canary values: `image.tag: 2026-03-20-canary` and `chartVersion: 3.2.0` in overlays/canary/values.yaml.

jon: I can apply the rollback now if someone approves. Command I'll run (dry-run then apply):
```
# dry-run first
helm upgrade --install user-service ./charts/user-service \
  --namespace canary \
  --values overlays/canary/values.yaml \
  --version 3.2.0 --dry-run
# then real
helm upgrade --install user-service ./charts/user-service \
  --namespace canary --values overlays/canary/values.yaml --version 3.2.0
```

sophia: Confirmed dry-run looks good. After rollout I'll watch 503/5xx and readiness for 10m.

leah: I'll update the release notes: add entry "user-service: chart v3.2.1 renamed serviceSessionAffinity -> sessionAffinity; rolled back canary to 3.2.0; follow-up patch planned" and flag as hotfix. Also opening a change-window exemption for immediate canary rollback.

alex: :thumbsup: go ahead jon. Also assign the follow-up to maya and me to cut 3.2.2 with backward-compatible keys.

ci-bot: CI check for PR #2345 (maya/pin-canary) passed unit tests and linting.

jon: Rolled back canary to chart v3.2.0. Canary pods are coming up — 4/4 ready. Health checks passing in the last 3 minutes. Marking thread resolved-ish, continue monitoring.

deploy-bot: Canary success confirmed. Running post-deploy smoke tests.

maya: I'll open PR for chart fix (3.2.2) with compatibility layer and add a migration note. ETA 2h.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the release notes doc and schedule a brief postmortem if the chart rename wasn't communicated to integrators.

leah: Filing a short blameless postmortem and linking PRs. Closing thread after 1h of stable canary. :white_check_mark:
